name: pdfmill — New order to packing slip PDF, saved to Drive

parameters.content:
## 📦 Order → Packing Slip PDF → Drive
On a new order, generate a packing slip PDF and file it (or attach it to the fulfilment task).

**Setup:** a **pdfmill** credential on the Generate node and a **Google Drive** credential on the save node.

### In production
Replace the manual trigger with your store’s **order webhook** (Shopify/WooCommerce/etc.) and map the order into the packing-slip fields.
